description: This file defines utility functions, types, and options for integrating Prometheus metrics with gRPC middleware, including error handling, metric options configuration, and context-based label/exemplar extraction.

classes.name: CounterOption
classes.description: Function type for configuring Counter metrics.

classes.name: counterOptions
classes.description: Slice of CounterOption with an apply method to configure CounterOpts.

classes.name: HistogramOption
classes.description: Function type for configuring Histogram metrics.

classes.name: histogramOptions
classes.description: Slice of HistogramOption with an apply method to configure HistogramOpts.

classes.name: config
classes.description: Configuration struct for prometheus interceptors, holding exemplar and label functions.

methods.name: FromError
methods.description: Converts an error to a gRPC status, handling context errors.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a list of Option functions to a config object.

methods.name: WithExemplarFromContext
methods.description: Sets the function to deduce exemplars from context.

methods.name: WithLabelsFromContext
methods.description: Sets the function to extract labels from context for metrics.
